text:
maya: CI main is red — integration-tests failing in GH Actions: decrypt step returns AccessDenied. Last green ~45m ago after a deploy. Rerun didn't help. Any idea if app tokens rotated? @aj

aj: saw the alert, looking. Was there a creds rotation earlier? CI secret 'GHA_KMS_KEY' was touched by infra/ops yesterday per audit.

sasha: quick check — I can reproduce locally with the runner. here's the log snippet:
```stderr
Error: KMS decrypt failed: AccessDenied
    at kms.decrypt (/opt/runner/lib/kms.js:42)
    at processTask (/opt/runner/lib/worker.js:88)
```

cheng: pinging GH app and vault. @ci-bot can you show the last repo secret change?

ci-bot: repo secret 'GHA_KMS_KEY' changed by infra-bot at 2026-03-17T09:22:01Z — scope: repo, action: update

aj: that explains it — GitHub App token might not have 'secrets' or the proper repo scope after the reinstall. Did we reinstall the app earlier today and drop scopes? @sasha any memory of that?

sasha: yeah we did an org-level reinstall for cleanup at ~08:50, I thought scopes were preserved but maybe not for some repos. We can re-add the app or re-authorise the repo. Workaround: add a temporary repo secret encrypted with the runner's PAT so workflows can proceed.

maya: can we bisect to last green? requesting a bisect on integration-tests from sha abc123..def456 so we can confirm no code regression. If infra fixes perms, rerun will be better.

aj: starting a quick bisect now. If it's permission-only, commit bisect won't change results — but this will confirm. I'll also try a rerun injecting a temporary PAT to validate.

deploy-bot: trigger: workflow_dispatch for integration-tests by aj — run_id: 4589123

aj: rerun with PAT succeeded — integration-tests passed. So this is auth-related, not test regression. We need GH App reinstall/perm fix. @cheng can you coordinate with platform to regrant 'actions:secrets' (repo-level read) for the app on this repo?

cheng: opening a ticket and will regrant the missing permission. Also adding follow-up to check why the reinstall dropped scopes for some repos. Will update when done.

maya: thanks — marking bisect on hold. Rerun success with PAT, so no code rollback needed. Please post here when app perms are restored so we can rotate secrets back from the temporary PAT. :thumbsup:
